research_question: What work is actually performed by the closure candidate frontier used in the Gen7 observer loop, without misattributing the last behavioral-search counters?
key_correction: The live closure path dispatches to RecursiveCognitiveCompiler.synthesize_process_frontier(), which enumerates with _exprs() and evaluates each expression against discovery rows. It does not call behavioral_search.find_exact_expression(). Profiling only ACSIE_SEARCH_PROFILE inside behavioral_search would therefore observe the wrong routine and could accidentally continue to the expensive primary search.

changes: counts attempted _exprs candidate evaluations, exact discovery-qualified candidates, and caught expression errors
emits per-policy candidate-list size and fixed-work progress snapshots
raises SystemExit(76) after the configured expression-attempt budget, before evaluating the next expression
original loop remains separate and unchanged when profiling is disabled

lab/acsie_open_ended_self_extending_prov.purpose: phase observer; explicitly labels missing last_search_stats as unavailable rather than reusing stale stats

bounded_work_protocol.scope: first closure synthesis call reached after restoring Gen7 state

scientific_controls: No target expression, target identity, holdout, transfer or OOD labels are added to candidate generation.
Only enumeration attempts and discovery-only fit outcomes already used by the live frontier are counted.
The cutoff is explicit and occurs before the next expression is evaluated.
Do not use this bounded profiler as a science-pass result.
